declaration: Written before the first solve of the explicit bipolar morphology; no human or engineered-cell calibration is claimed.
parameterRationale: The bipolar topology and soma range follow the requested architecture. Stem geometry is explicitly hypothetical. Each arm uses a tabulated MRG motor-fiber geometry rather than extrapolating that table. Soma and stems use 10% of the nodal active conductance densities as a declared distributed-membrane hypothesis; it is not a measured density or a fitted value. Published nodal leak and reversal potentials are unchanged. The density grid tests this assumption, including the original nodal-density extreme. Fifty milliseconds is a declared numerical preparation, not a balancing current.
controls: Unmodified shared equilibrium, zero drive, local active-conductance removal in soma/both stems/one heminode each arm, all active sites removed, and separately disconnected native-arm stumps. A missing relay junction is not fabricated. Negative causal results are retained, not forced to pass.
failurePolicy: Every failed numerical attempt and every spontaneous or nonrecruited sensitivity case remains recorded. Physiological feasibility is not a numerical pass criterion. Numerical limits will not be relaxed to hide a failure.
